name: Zavu Inbox
author: Zavu
description: Read and reply to every conversation your Zavu numbers are having, without leaving the shell

barWidget.description: Unread count in the bar, recent threads and a reply box in the panel

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to check for new messages while idle. The panel and the inbox poll faster while open.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Off silences every inbound notification. The unread dot in the bar stays either way.

schema.label: Enter sends the reply
schema.description: When off, Enter adds a newline and Ctrl+Enter sends.

schema.label: Dashboard language
schema.description: Used when opening the dashboard in your browser.

schema.label: Threads per refresh
schema.description: How many conversations each refresh asks for. Lower is lighter; the inbox still paginates past this.

schema.label: Messages per thread
schema.description: How much history to load when you open a thread.
